ns2:course.label: Graduate Capstone Project
ns2:course.description: Major individual project that demonstrates a PSM in GIS student's ability to solve an advanced geospatial problem or develop a GIS-based application. Student will work closely with a faculty capstone adviser to determine the project focus and expected outcome(s). 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Restricted to second-year PSM in GIS students.
